item.tib: sdug bsngal zhi gcod zin chung rig sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: de ltar zhi gcod kyi nyams su len ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus su bkod pa 'di ni/ rang gzhan blo dman dad ldan rigs rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du g.yung tshul bdag gis bon gyi 'dus gnas g.yas ru mkhar dgon du sbyar bas/ 'gal gyur bshags shing dge bas mnyam med bla ma'i ring lugs mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig mu tsug smar ro//
